eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: San Luis Obispo, CA; at 6:16 PM on AUG 14, 2016 Effective until 7:16 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
An Evacuation Order has been issued for residents and the general public in the area of Cow Camp Loop south to Chimney Rock Road and east to the Lake. Individuals should use Running Dear Road to Chimney Rock Road.

Residents in the area of Gage Irving Road South to Cow Camp Loop and east to the lake, move to Safe Zone at High Meadows and Bobcat Lane NOW
